system:
You grade one change in an experiment. You are given the change request, the problem the
researcher seeded in it (the answer key: `none`, or a conflict or breakage and what it is against),
and the elements the request is bound to. Then, under the labels A, B and C, three versions of the
same change: each label's edit, and the flags its pre-deploy checks raised, run by run. Each flag
has an id (`label.run.index`). Grade every label on the same scale.

Label every flag, by its id:
- `seeded`: it identifies the seeded problem (the same conflict or breakage, in any words)
- `other-real`: it is a real problem with this change, but not the seeded one
- `false-alarm`: it is not a real problem

Then judge each label's edit: did it implement the request (`implements`), only part of it
(`partial`), or not at all (`does-not`)? Judge only whether it does what was asked, not whether
that is wise.

Reply with JSON only:
{"flags": [{"id": "A.1.0", "label": "seeded | other-real | false-alarm", "why": "one sentence"}],
 "edits": [{"label": "A", "fidelity": "implements | partial | does-not", "why": "one sentence"}]}

{"id":"B.2.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"Untested handoff keying is speculation, not a defect."},
{"id":"B.2.3","label":"false-alarm","why":"A compatible enum widening needs no version bump."},
{"id":"B.3.0","label":"false-alarm","why":"The missing staging fixture is not a defect, and Delivery accepts any environment string."},
{"id":"B.3.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"A stale source quote is not a functional problem."},
{"id":"B.3.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"A compatible enum widening needs no version bump."},
{"id":"B.4.0","label":"other-real","why":"Real gap: the environment never reaches the kernel."},
{"id":"B.4.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"Missing staging fixtures and scenarios are not a real defect."},
{"id":"B.4.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"Provenance and version concerns are not real defects."},
{"id":"B.5.0","label":"other-real","why":"Real gap: the environment is not passed, so staging deploys as local."},
{"id":"B.5.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"The missing staging fixture and glossary wording are not real defects."},
{"id":"B.5.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"Source evidence for the new enum value is a provenance quibble."},
{"id":"C.1.0","label":"false-alarm","why":"The add_source local_only warning is unrelated to this change and was not introduced by it."}
],
"edits":[
{"label":"A","fidelity":"implements","why":"Adds staging to the deliver environment enum in the authoring docs."},
{"label":"B","fidelity":"implements","why":"Adds staging to the deliver environment enum in the authoring domain."},
{"label":"C","fidelity":"implements","why":"Adds staging to the enum; the extra change to proposed status does not remove it."}
]}
